insights.summary: Amazon delivered strong Q3 2023 results with revenue of $143.1 billion (12.6% YoY growth) and net income of $9.9 billion compared to $2.9 billion in Q3 2022, driven by AWS growth and improved operating efficiency across segments. The company significantly reduced capex spending by 23.8% YoY to $12.5 billion while maintaining robust operating cash flow of $21.2 billion, reflecting improved capital discipline and operational leverage. However, management enacted approximately $500 million in severance costs for planned role eliminations and faces substantial regulatory headwinds including major FTC antitrust litigation, though the company maintains strong pricing power with advertising services growing 26.4% YoY.
